title: President Trump says Micron will invest $250M in Trump Accounts; Micron says it will come via an employee matching program and a $250 deposit in some US states (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: President Trump says Micron will invest $250M in Trump Accounts; Micron says it will come via an employee matching program and a $250 deposit in some US states — President Trump said the U.S. chip maker would make a significant donation to a new type of investment account created by the administration.
